content: On Friday, August 30, 2013, at 10:30 AM, Dr. Philippe Gabriel Steg will discuss the topic TAO: Otamixaban in non-ST-segment elevation acute coronary syndrome patients undergoing a planned invasive strategy. The embargo for this information will lift on Sunday, September 1, 2013, at 11:36 AM. On Saturday, August 31, 2013, at 11:30 AM, Dr. Frank Peacock, a member of the APEX Steering Committee, will address Challenges and Solutions in the APEX Study. On Sunday, September 1, 2013, at 8:30 AM, Dr. Stephen James Nicholls will present findings from the ASSURE study, titled Effect of an Oral Agent Inducing Apo A-I Synthesis on Progression of Coronary Atherosclerosis. The embargo for this data will lift on Monday, September 2, 2013, at 11:54 AM. Additionally, Dr. Nicholls will discuss the AQUARIUS study, Effect of the Renin Inhibitor Aliskiren on Progression of Coronary Atherosclerosis, with an embargo lifting on Tuesday, September 3, 2013, at 11:54 AM. At 10:00 AM on the same day, Dr. Chuck Shear will discuss The Development of the CSL-112 Study. Later, at 1:45 PM, Dr. Bela Merkely and Dr. Toth Attila will present on The EMBRACE-MI Study, followed by Dr. Doug Weaver at 2:00 PM, who will also discuss The EMBRACE-MI Study. On Monday, September 2, 2013, at 8:00 AM, Dr. Nassir Marrouche will present findings from the DECAAF study, titled Delayed Enhancement – MRI Determinant of Successful Catheter Ablation of Atrial Fibrillation: Analysis of Post-Ablation Scar and Outcome. The embargo for this data will lift on Sunday, September 1, 2013, at 2:36 PM. At 11:00 AM, Dr. Robert Harrington will discuss The Development of the CSL-112 Study. At 12:30 PM, Dr. Roxana Mehran will present findings from the PARIS study, titled Incidence and Impact of Dual Antiplatelet Therapy Cessation on Adverse Cardiac Events Following Percutaneous Coronary Intervention: Two-Year Results. The embargo for this data will lift on Sunday, September 1, 2013, at 12:12 PM. At 1:00 PM, Dr. Sten Rubertsson will discuss the LINC study, A Multicenter Randomized Trial Comparing a Mechanical CPR Algorithm Using LUCAS vs. Manual CPR in Out-of-Hospital Cardiac Arrest Patients. The embargo for this data will lift on Sunday, September 1, 2013, at 3:12 PM. At 1:30 PM, Dr. Ole Fröbert will present findings from the TASTE study, Thrombus Aspiration During ST-Segment Elevation Myocardial Infarction: A Multicenter, Prospective, Registry-Based Randomized Clinical Trial. The embargo for this data will lift on Sunday, September 1, 2013, at 11:18 AM. At 2:00 PM, Dr. Renato Lopes will provide an ESC wrap-up in Portuguese, followed by Dr. Basil Lewis at 2:30 PM, who will provide an ESC wrap-up in Hebrew. At 4:00 PM, Dr. Sergio Leonardi and Professor Diego Ardissino will provide an ESC wrap-up in Italian. On Tuesday, September 3, 2013, at 8:30 AM, Dr. Freek Verheugt will provide an ESC wrap-up from a Dutch perspective. At 10:00 AM, Dr. Harry Büller will discuss Treatment of Venous Thromboembolism: The Hokusai VTE Study. The embargo for this data will lift on Sunday, September 1, 2013, at 11:00 AM. At 10:30 AM, Dr. Maarten Groenink will present findings from the COMPARE study, titled Effect of Losartan on Aortic Dilation Rate in Adults with Marfan Syndrome. The embargo for this data will lift on Monday, September 2, 2013, at 12:12 PM. At 12:30 PM, Dr. Shinya Goto will discuss the ARISTOTLE sub-analysis, Efficacy and Safety of Apixaban Compared with Warfarin for Stroke Prevention in Atrial Fibrillation in East Asia. The embargo for this data will lift on Tuesday, September 3, 2013, at 2:00 PM. At 3:30 PM, Dr. John Teerlink will present findings from the ATOMIC-AHF study, titled Acute Treatment with Omecamtiv Mecarbil to Increase Contractility in Acute Heart Failure. The embargo for this data will lift on Tuesday, September 3, 2013, at 11:18 AM. At 4:00 PM, Dr. Stefan James will provide an ESC wrap-up from a Scandinavian perspective. At 4:30 PM, Dr. Gilles Montalescot will discuss the ACCOAST trial, A Comparison of Prasugrel at PCI or Time of Diagnosis of Non-ST Elevation Myocardial Infarction. The embargo for this data will lift on Sunday, September 1, 2013, at 2:18 PM.
